parameters.name: BackendServers
parameters.description:
The list of backend servers to add. The list contains the following parameters:

- **ServerId**: String. Required. The instance ID of the backend server. Valid values: ECS instance ID, ENI instance ID, and ECI instance ID. If you set **ServerId** to an ENI instance ID or an ECI instance ID, the **Type** parameter is required.

- **Weight**: The backend server weight. Valid values: **0** to **100**. Default value: **100**.
    
 If the value is 0, no requests are forwarded to the backend server.

- **Description**: String. Optional. The description of the backend server. The description must be 1 to 80 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), and underscores (_). Chinese characters are supported.

- **Type**: The server type of the backend server. Valid values:

    - **ecs**: ECS instance (default).
    
    - **eni**: elastic network interface controller (NIC) instance.

    - **eci**: elastic container instance.

> Only guaranteed-performance instances support adding eni and eci types of backend servers.

*  **ServerIp**: The IP address of the ENI or ECI instance.

Examples:

* Mount an ECS instance:
 
 `[{ "ServerId": "i-xxxxxxxxx", "Weight": "100", "Type": "ecs", "Description":"test-112" }]`

* Mount an ENI:

  `[{ "ServerId": "eni-xxxxxxxxx", "Weight": "100", "Type": "eni", "ServerIp": "192.168.**.**", "Description":"test-112" }]`

*  Mount an ENI with multiple IP addresses:

  `[{ "ServerId": "eni-xxxxxxxxx", "Weight": "100", "Type": "eni", "ServerIp": "192.168.**.**", "Description":"test-113" },{ "ServerId": "eni-xxxxxxxxx", "Weight": "100", "Type": "eni", "ServerIp": "172.166.**.**", "Description":"test-113" }]`

* Mount an ECI:

  `[{ "ServerId": "eci-xxxxxxxxx", "Weight": "100", "Type": "eci", "ServerIp": "192.168.**.**", "Description":"test-114" }]`

> Only backend servers in the Running state can be added to an SLB instance. You can add up to 20 backend servers in each invoke.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerId
parameters.description: The ID of the Classic Load Balancer instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where the SLB instance is deployed.

You can invoke [DescribeRegions](~~27584~~) to query region IDs.
